_what_this_is: The Product half of the Factory's domain_vocab_ratchet.py (D-14). PRODUCT.md's layer rule: source adapters own provider-specific discovery, cursors and fetches; KnowledgeCore, the Brain API and DataCore's shared substrate stay source-agnostic. The files below claim to be provider-free; each carries the provider-vocabulary count it has today as a ceiling, and a file that GAINS provider vocabulary fails.
_provenance: Written 2026-10-21 for WO-2026-10-21-1 item 5. MasterBrain has no JSON domain schema to harvest, so the vocabulary is declared: the mail-provider and protocol names the adapters (src/email_brain/connectors, fastmail_enrollment) own. Ceilings measured with `domain_vocab_ratchet.py scan` the same day; lower them with `baseline`, never raise without --allow-raise and a reason.
